name: lever side seated single arm rear delt fly
description: Seated sideways on a machine, you pull one arm back in a wide arc. It isolates the rear delt.
instructions: Sit sideways on the machine with your chest against the pad.
Grab the handle with the outside hand.
Start with your arm in front of you and a soft bend in your elbow.
Pull the handle out and back until your arm is in line with your shoulder.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
